changeSet.author: wasnertobias
changeSet.comment: Re-replaces the logos_resolve_unit_price of changelog 023 (changeSet 022-2-resolve-unit-price) with the valid_to-aware version: the LATERAL now only matches rows that are still open at p_valid_at, so a generation closed by a provider type change is never selected again, while requests made before the close still match their closed row. A SQL-language function is validated at CREATE time, which is why this replacement lives in the same changelog as the column it references. The pre-023 budget_usage recreation is dropped instead: 023 rebuilt budget_usage on log_entry_cost, which picks up the boundary through this function.
changeSet.sql: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION logos_resolve_unit_price( p_quantity text, p_model_id integer, p_provider_id integer, p_valid_at timestamptz, p_context_tokens bigint, p_service_tier text ) RETURNS bigint LANGUAGE sql STABLE AS $fn$ WITH chain(name, depth) AS ( SELECT p_quantity, 0 UNION ALL SELECT x.fb, x.d FROM (VALUES ('billed_input_cache_read', 'billed_input_uncached', 1), ('billed_input_cache_write', 'billed_input_uncached', 1), ('billed_input_cache_write_1h', 'billed_input_cache_write', 1), ('billed_input_cache_write_1h', 'billed_input_uncached', 2), ('billed_input_audio', 'billed_input_uncached', 1), ('billed_input_audio_cache_read','billed_input_audio', 1), ('billed_input_audio_cache_read','billed_input_cache_read', 2), ('billed_input_audio_cache_read','billed_input_uncached', 3), ('billed_input_audio_cache_write','billed_input_audio', 1), ('billed_input_audio_cache_write','billed_input_cache_write',2), ('billed_input_audio_cache_write','billed_input_uncached', 3), ('billed_input_image_tokens', 'billed_input_uncached', 1), ('billed_output_reasoning', 'billed_output_text', 1), ('billed_output_audio', 'billed_output_text', 1), ('billed_output_image_tokens', 'billed_output_text', 1) ,('billed_output_video_tokens', 'billed_output_text', 1) -- Most catalogues carry only the scalar search price, so -- fall size-suffixed low/high quantities back to it. ,('billed_search_queries_low', 'billed_search_queries', 1) ,('billed_search_queries_high', 'billed_search_queries', 1) ,('billed_search_prompts_low', 'billed_search_prompts', 1) ,('billed_search_prompts_high', 'billed_search_prompts', 1) ) AS x(orig, fb, d) WHERE x.orig = p_quantity ) SELECT price.price_per_k_unit FROM chain c JOIN token_types tt ON tt.name = c.name JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT tp.price_per_k_unit FROM token_prices tp WHERE tp.type_id = tt.id AND tp.unit = CASE WHEN c.name LIKE '%characters' THEN 'character' WHEN c.name LIKE '%images' THEN 'image' WHEN c.name LIKE '%pixels' THEN 'pixel' WHEN c.name LIKE '%milliseconds%' OR c.name = 'audio_milliseconds' THEN 'millisecond' WHEN c.name LIKE '%pages' THEN 'page' WHEN c.name LIKE '%credits' THEN 'credit' WHEN c.name LIKE '%queries%' THEN 'query' WHEN c.name LIKE '%prompts%' THEN 'request' WHEN c.name = 'billed_requests' THEN 'request' WHEN c.name LIKE '%sessions' THEN 'session' WHEN c.name LIKE 'billed_guardrail_%' THEN 'unit' ELSE 'token' END AND (tp.model_id = p_model_id OR tp.model_id IS NULL) AND (tp.provider_id = p_provider_id OR tp.provider_id IS NULL) AND tp.valid_from <= p_valid_at AND (tp.valid_to IS NULL OR tp.valid_to > p_valid_at) AND tp.min_context_tokens <= COALESCE(p_context_tokens, 0) AND (tp.service_tier = COALESCE(p_service_tier, 'default') OR tp.service_tier = 'default') ORDER BY (tp.model_id = p_model_id) DESC NULLS LAST, (tp.provider_id = p_provider_id) DESC NULLS LAST, (tp.service_tier = COALESCE(p_service_tier, 'default')) DESC, tp.min_context_tokens DESC, tp.valid_from DESC, tp.id DESC LIMIT 1 ) price ON true ORDER BY c.depth LIMIT 1 $fn$;
